title: Dental Laboratory Technicians
description: Construct and repair full or partial dentures or dental appliances.

tasks.text: Read prescriptions or specifications and examine models or impressions to determine the design of dental products to be constructed.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Test appliances for conformance to specifications and accuracy of occlusion, using articulators and micrometers.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical device inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect medical or dental assistive devices.

tasks.text: Fabricate, alter, or repair dental devices, such as dentures, crowns, bridges, inlays, or appliances for straightening teeth.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Customized device construction is hands-on fabrication

dwas.name: Construct customized assistive medical or dental devices.
Repair medical or dental assistive devices.

tasks.text: Place tooth models on an apparatus that mimics bite and movement of patient's jaw to evaluate functionality of model.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical body measurement for fit

dwas.name: Measure clients to ensure proper product fit.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Remove excess metal or porcelain and polish surfaces of prostheses or frameworks, using polishing machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.
Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.

tasks.text: Train or supervise other dental technicians or dental laboratory bench workers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Equipment instruction requires live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Instruct workers to use equipment or perform technical procedures.
Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Melt metals or mix plaster, porcelain, or acrylic pastes and pour materials into molds or over frameworks to form dental prostheses or apparatuses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mixing finishes requires hands-on craft judgment

dwas.name: Mix ingredients to create specific finishes.
Place materials into molds.
Melt metal, plastic, or other materials to prepare for production.

tasks.text: Prepare metal surfaces for bonding with porcelain to create artificial teeth, using small hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical preparation of materials by hand

dwas.name: Prepare materials for processing.

tasks.text: Rebuild or replace linings, wire sections, or missing teeth to repair dentures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of assistive devices

dwas.name: Repair medical or dental assistive devices.

tasks.text: Apply porcelain paste or wax over prosthesis frameworks or setups, using brushes and spatulas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying parting agents is manual mold prep

dwas.name: Apply parting agents or other solutions to molds.

tasks.text: Build and shape wax teeth, using small hand instruments and information from observations or dentists' specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Customized device construction is hands-on fabrication

dwas.name: Construct customized assistive medical or dental devices.

tasks.text: Load newly constructed teeth into porcelain furnaces to bake the porcelain onto the metal framework.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual loading into hot ovens or furnaces

dwas.name: Load items into ovens or furnaces.

tasks.text: Mold wax over denture setups to form the full contours of artificial gums.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Casting molds of patient anatomy is manual lab work

dwas.name: Cast molds of patient anatomies to create medical or dental devices.

tasks.text: Create a model of patient's mouth by pouring plaster into a dental impression and allowing plaster to set.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Casting molds of patient anatomy is manual lab work

dwas.name: Place materials into molds.
Cast molds of patient anatomies to create medical or dental devices.

tasks.text: Prepare wax bite blocks and impression trays for use.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assembly of medical supplies

dwas.name: Prepare medical supplies or equipment for use.

tasks.text: Shape and solder wire and metal frames or bands for dental products, using soldering irons and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Shape metal workpieces with hammers or other small hand tools.
Solder parts or workpieces.

tasks.text: Fill chipped or low spots in surfaces of devices, using acrylic resins.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Filling cracks is manual finishing work

dwas.name: Fill cracks, imperfections, or holes in products or workpieces.

emerging_tasks.task: Meet with dentists or patients to discuss dental appliances.
Order parts or materials needed to make dental appliances.
Scan dental models to create digital files.
Stain porcelain on dental appliances to match the color of patients' teeth.
